violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Serve Safe manager must renew FMC license with RIDOH CFP. Application provided. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/11/2026
The consumer advisory provided does not disclose the foods on the menu that are raw or undercooked. Establishment must add disclosure to food items. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on the prep unit, and low boy unit on the cooking line. Gaskets must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/11/2026
Ceiling tiles by the front counter were observed in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/11/2026
The hood filters were observed with an excess of debris. Hood filters must be maintained. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Owner/Employees in process of re-certifying. New Violation. Correct By: 07/17/2025

Meat, and cheese was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/17/2025
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on the two door stand up in the dining room. Gaskets must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 05/17/2025

The ceiling above the stove is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. The floor by the mechanical dishwasher is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/17/2025
